name: Jarvis
blurb: An instrument that displays the machine's measured state.

provenance.note: Jarvis was registered inline in characters.ts while Familiar came from a bundle; this manifest makes both bodies the same kind of thing. He names his OWN canvas source: the shader source supplies the Familiar's uniform set, and Jarvis needs a different one entirely (budgets, work, speech, readout), so drawing him through it would have been refused at registration -- correctly. uGene is listed because the shader needs it, though JarvisRenderer uploads it once at mount rather than per frame. scripts/check_jarvis_shader.sh pins the vendored frag against its canon copy.
